answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the willow release is recorded with every signature, the tundra audit exposes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the signal graph and each risks its bond. That is 13 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
